# construct generic implementation and validate on both received examples
code2='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate the framed panel: its border color occupies the first column and
    # the panel ends immediately before the all-background separator.
    bg = 0
    border = grid[0][0]
    right = max(c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == border for r in range(h)))
    panel_w = right + 1
    # Find horizontal separator rows that are solid border color.
    bands = []
    for r in range(h):
        if all(grid[r][c] == border for c in range(panel_w)):
            bands.append(r)
    # Objects on the right are connected same-color components.
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(panel_w, w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                rr,cc=stack.pop(); cells.append((rr,cc))
                for nr,nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and panel_w <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
            minr=min(x for x,y in cells); maxr=max(x for x,y in cells)
            minc=min(y for x,y in cells); maxc=max(y for x,y in cells)
            mask=frozenset((x-minr,y-minc) for x,y in cells)
            objects.append((maxr-minr+1,maxc-minc+1,mask,color))
    out=[row[:panel_w] for row in grid]
    for i in range(len(bands)-1):
        top,bottom=bands[i],bands[i+1]
        # Interior is bounded by the repeated frame border.
        holes={(r-top-1,c-1) for r in range(top+1,bottom) for c in range(1,panel_w-1) if grid[r][c] == bg}
        if not holes: continue
        mh=max(r for r,c in holes)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in holes)+1
        mask=frozenset(holes)
        for oh,ow,om,color in objects:
            if (oh,ow,om)==(mh,mw,mask):
                for r,c in holes: out[top+1+r][1+c]=color
                break
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code2)
